transcript: Speaker A: A for Apple, B for Ball jaisi English toh seekh li, lekin aaj tak English mein dhang se ek sentence tak nahi bol paate ho. Aise toh tumhari koi izzat nahi karega. Isse accha tum aaj ke aaj is app par roz sirf 15 minute English ki practice karke dekho. Phir dekhna kaise farratedar English bolte ho. Is app ko English Seekho app kehte hain. Yahan sirf sikhane wale videos aate hain aur koi ads bhi nahi aate. English Seekho app pe Spoken English yaani bolne wali angrezi ka ek show aata hai. Expert chhote-chhote videos mein step-by-step English bolna sikhate hain. Toh bas roz ka 15 minute nikalo, expert ke videos dekho, AI coach se practice karo. Trial sirf ek rupaye ka hai. Phir dekhna kuch dino mein tumhari English dekh ke log dang reh jayenge. Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [You learned English like 'A for Apple, B for Ball', but till today you can't even speak a single sentence properly in English. No one will respect you like this. It's better you practice English on this app for just 15 minutes daily starting today. Then see how fluently you speak English. This app is called English Seekho app. Only educational videos appear here and there are no ads. On the English Seekho app, there is a show for Spoken English. Experts teach you to speak English step-by-step in short videos. So just take out 15 minutes daily, watch expert videos, practice with the AI coach. The trial is only for one rupee. Then see, in a few days, people will be amazed looking at your English. So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
